_about: Original North American release date per game row (one-time import 2026-11-18): IGDB, cross-checked with Steam, App Store, and eShop dates and each game's Wikipedia article; 90 doubtful ones checked by Ronjan, then every game compared with its own Wikipedia article and the 67 disagreements checked by Ronjan. Early access games use the full release date. Rules: a combined row (Persona 5 + Royal) uses the first game's original date; an expanded version played on its own (Persona 4 Golden) uses that version's date; remakes are their own rows. null = no release date (apps like Switch Online).
